data.name: Khaleed
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'Khalaada' which means 'to keep alive, to keep eternal'. This name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Falaq (113:1), where Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is instructed to seek refuge in Allah from the evil that He has created, ending with the phrase 'You are indeed the Forgiving, the Merciful. You are indeed the Lord of the Eternal, the Forgiving.'
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reminding us of Allah's eternal and forgiving nature.
